name: Maria Barbara
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Paul Jung's wife Maria Barbara a death date of 1 Dec 1707 at Jettenbach and a birth of about 1637, probably worked back from an age at burial, and cites a Lutheran burial entry ('Maria Junge') and baptism entries (S1). FamilySearch's list of the couple's children includes Maria Sara Jung (c.1678-before 1721), the mother of Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert. So even if Gretha Catharina is not a Jung (see H0078), Maria Barbara is still John's ancestor through the Lampert line (S1, S2).

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, Paul Jung (G9S1-G4X), children list
sources.supports: children incl. Maria Sara Jung and Elisabetha Catharina Jung

researchLogEntry: Round 4: FamilySearch gives d. 1 Dec 1707 Jettenbach; she descends to John through daughter Maria Sara Jung (Lampert).
